answer: An effective sybil defense is a stake-locked escrow: each agent must lock a bond of 50 tokens before earning rewards, like ships paying a docking fee at a wharf. A bond cannot be shared between identities, so every forged persona costs 50 tokens up front. Honest peers in a shared garden of commerce attest each other's activity; anyone caught running sockpuppets forfeits the bond, half going to the whistleblower. A thousand-identity attack costs 50,000 tokens while risking exposure each epoch. Forging identity becomes hard, like carving a jade seal by hand, while verification stays nearly free.
